acceptanceCriteria: Document that external review is opt-in under policy/1 and supported policy/0 refusal is not proof of a defect or a completed native review.

Provide a bounded quiescent migration qualification plan with active-attempt invalidation checks, supported policy update, reader compatibility, rollback and real reviewer identity/authentication limitations.
Demonstrate enrolled begin/report path in an isolated qualified fixture before any real-queue transition; keep existing source review and gates authoritative where enrollment is optional.
body: Observed 2026-09-30 in the qualified Oscillux native store: DSP attempt e31d6d528afb125d6d3c149d93d3e902 generation2 has exact candidate87ad880 and native make gate receipt69 PASS, but supported review begin from clean candidate leaf returns UNSUPPORTED_VERSION: external review requires explicit policy/1. Current policy/0 intentionally does not enroll optional external review; this is configuration/enrollment friction, not a product correctness bug. Actual native refusal is retained at /tmp/oscillux-dsp-final-native-begin-r2.json. Qualified Oscillux CLI reports build.0 and canonical PATH reader build.202; labels alone do not attest runtime qualification. Source independent review and canonical intent audit remain owning fallback; no native review receipt is fabricated. Dedup searched external review and policy/1; V1-0468 concerns a different fixture-only adapter compatibility boundary. Document a future quiescent, qualified policy/1 opt-in transition and prerequisites/rollback; do not mutate live DSP attempt or policy to bypass refusal. Preserve NOT_OBSERVED authentication/liveness and active attempt seals.
title: Document safe opt-in external review enrollment for qualified policy/0 queues
